# Drone News 48h Brief — August 25, 2026

_Window: last 48 hours; 66 incidents._

## Summary
In the last 48 hours, a diverse range of drone-related incidents has been reported, predominantly in Romania and Germany. Notably, Romania has seen unauthorized drone incursions triple compared to the previous year, raising security concerns. In Germany, multiple drones linked to incidents at Leipzig Airport have been found, some containing explosives. Meanwhile, prisons across several regions, including Virginia and Sussex, have reported substantial smuggling attempts with contraband worth over $300,000 being dropped via drones. In Vietnam, an airport drill was conducted in response to drone disruptions, highlighting the increasing need for responsive measures in airport security. The incidents underline ongoing challenges in managing drone activities that interfere with public safety and national security.
